name: Render
subtitle: Unified PaaS (Heroku-style)
creator: Anurag Goel
description: Git-based deploys for web services, static sites, background workers, cron jobs, managed Postgres and Redis-compatible Key Value, with infrastructure as code through Blueprints.
useCases: Full-stack apps with a server, database and workers
Django, Rails, Node and FastAPI apps

languages.youWrite: Node, Python, Ruby, Go, Rust, Elixir or Docker; config in render.yaml

concepts.explanation: Web, worker, cron and static site types.

codeSamples.label: YAML · render.yaml
codeSamples.code:
services:
  - type: web
    name: api
    runtime: node
    buildCommand: npm ci && npm run build
    startCommand: npm start
    envVars:
      - key: DATABASE_URL
        fromDatabase:
          name: main-db
          property: connectionString
databases:
  - name: main-db

pricing.summary: Hobby workspace: $0 plus compute. Pro workspace: $25/mo. Web services from $7/mo (Starter); free instances sleep after 15 minutes idle. Postgres from $6/mo.
